I'm Dr. Haseeb Ashraf [DVM]. This channel is devised for the betterment and progress of people belonging to livestock, poultry, fisheries, pet animals, and agriculture.

Being a Veterinary Doctor I can never forget about the health of livestock, pets, and stray animals. So I'll also update people about their worth and how to take care of them for their good health and well-being.
